aggregation: Per-image mean within each structure/domain, then unweighted structure/domain macro; mean and sample SD across 3 seeds. Metrics CSV is rounded to 4 decimals; reported calculated means inherit that rounding.
cohort_note: positive_surface_defined retains positive GT with at least one observable target boundary. GT-only selection independent of predictions. Empty predictions remain and receive 512-grid diagonal 722.6631 pixel penalty. Structure: 2501/2501; union: 1601/1603 excluding 2 AUL images whose GT boundary is unknown. positive retains all 1603 union positives and undefined distances.
scope: Dense shared path normalization only; sparse experts remain GN. Domain variants require dataset ID. All 4 arms share image_mean; these are not Q01 organ-weighted arms.
findings: Domain BN is worse than shared BN on all three seeds for both overall and abdomen positive DSC; vessel output collapses on seeds 43 and 44 (100% empty prediction on vessel-positive test images).
Shared BN improves abdomen/vessels over shared GN on all three seeds, but worsens spleen and increases false positives; union DSC decreases. This is not a universal improvement.
Domain GN slightly improves mean overall DSC but only 2/3 seed gains; vessel gains consistent, but kidney and spleen DSC decrease; surface distances do not consistently improve.

Only 3 seeds, same fixed data split, no confidence interval or significance claim. Domain subbatches are usually one image; possible running-statistics instability is a hypothesis, not causal proof. No mixed normalization + weighted-loss result yet.
